decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel sits at the core of the firm's binding mobile communication strategy, its prospects are still uncertain after one year, and keeping a software feature on the market costs little.
Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's push toward online contract signing, so the option stays open while eIDAS-driven demand plays out at low maintenance cost.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a platform-level offering that underpins the other products, so abandoning it would destroy related options.
The email-to-app delivery robot is a niche add-on with more uncertain value, but one year of evidence is too little to justify dropping a cheap software option.
The QR hardware token carries higher holding costs and faces app-based substitution, but its value for high-security customers is not yet disproven.
Payment network compliance is in demand from regulated customers, and the suite fits the firm's compliance expertise, so it is worth keeping while results come in.
